title.html: Every detail belongs to the experience.

body.html: Development follows the intended areas of use and the requirements of the responsible outfitter. Dimensions, storage and handling belong in the brief alongside any required documentation. Aviation-specific approvals require separate agreement; material selection or bespoke production does not replace that review.

A cabin project starts with accurate dimensions, stowage and a clear brief for use. With your design or outfitting team, we develop each accessory entirely around that brief. Our offer includes one-off commissions and very small runs, handmade in the EU. Material suitability is reviewed against your project’s mandatory requirements.

On-board use may involve specific requirements for materials and construction. Include these in the brief, together with the evidence your project team requires. Feasibility is assessed for the individual project. The product ideas presented here do not imply blanket aviation approval or certification.
Desk pads and notepad holders for suites, workspaces and meeting tables. Developed as a coordinated collection of formats, materials and branding.
